{{Top}}
A '''retinal scan''' was a biometric scanning technique that used the unique patterns on a person's retina to identify them.

[[Computer/Legends|Computers]] could be secured with retinal scans to prevent unauthorized access.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>

[[Darth Scabrous' HK droid]] used this to verify the identity of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Tulkh]] before escorting him to [[Darth Scabrous]]'s [[Laboratory/Legends|lab]].

During [[Jerec (Inquisitor)|Jerec]]'s search for the [[Valley of the Jedi]], renegade [[Kyle Katarn]] was detected on [[Sulon/Legends|Sulon]]. Residents of [[Barons Hed]] were eye-scanned by [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] forces before entering the [[city/Legends|city]], forming lines before its gates.<ref name="Dark Forces: Rebel Agent">''[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent]]''</ref>
